body.name: \(\operatorname{Disp}_{\mathbb T}\)
body.def: If \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}(F)=(a_F,\phi_F,\widetilde F)\), define \(\operatorname{Disp}_{\mathbb T}(F,y)=\widetilde y-\widetilde F(\widetilde y)=-a_F-\nabla\phi_F(\widetilde y)\); equivariance makes the value independent of the representative \(\widetilde y\) of \(y\), and the fixed Borel fallback makes the functional total.
